summary_for_children: Al-Infitar describes the end of the world in words and reminds us Allah created us in a beautiful form.
world_title: The Sky Breaks Apart in Words
environment_concept: A garden of forms that are well made and balanced: a great spiral shell, a symmetrical leaf in stone and an arch balanced on its own stones (82:7). Beside it, a table of fruit and water, gifts that remind us that our Lord is the Generous (82:6). The breaking sky and scattered stars of 82:1-4 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A spiral-shell sculpture, a stone leaf, a dry-stone arch, a table of fruit and water.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A rocky pine gorge with a rushing stream that the path crosses three times on narrow logs

primary_mechanic.text: Cross three logs: once you start to tip you tip further, and the log sways you; lean the other way to keep the balance needle in the middle while you walk 6 seconds across. Tipping too far sends you back to the bank (noted). The logs get springier (82:7, created, shaped and balanced).

secondary_activities: when the sky cleaves (82:1-5, read only)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading above the gorge, three log crossings, then a reading at the top
environment_behaviour: each log’s marker stone turns gold once crossed
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that Allah created us, shaped us and balanced us (82:6-8)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Nothing Is Forgotten
story_library.children_narration: The surah reminds us of the Day of Judgment and asks us to reflect on how wonderfully human beings are formed. It teaches that our actions matter and are not forgotten.

world_idea.title: The Gallery of Responsibility
world_idea.description: Explore interactive displays about human development and everyday choices. Represent accountability through a symbolic journal, not depictions of angels or divine records.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: The recording angels (82:10-12) are not shown; a personal journal is used, labelled as not the real record.
